note: The query set is the Wiz source itself: the deep embedding's rules are constructed in the harness. This file pins the programs, the parameters measured, and the deterministic derived-fact counts the driver checks before timing.

rules: tainted(y)  :- tainted(x), flow(x, y), not san(y)
alert(y, z) :- tainted(x), flow(x, y), sink(y, z)
chain.edb: flow(i, i+1) for i in [0, N), src(0), sink(i, 0) for i in [0, N)

rules: path(x, z) :- path(x, y), edge(y, z)
tc.edb: 8x8 edges from layer i to i+1 for i in [0, N), plus a spine edge (layer i+1,0) -> (layer i+2,0); the first N-1 spine edges duplicate the j=k=0 edge, so 64N+1 unique rows

naive.rules: every rule against the whole store, every round, until no new fact; same kernels as the semi-naive engine
naive.scope: positive programs; the two measured programs have an empty sanitiser relation, so the stratified and naive fixpoints coincide
